# Customer Reviews & Moderation Policy — Electronics (US)

## Overview

It must be noted that this customer reviews & moderation policy applies to all electronics purchases completed in the US storefront. The policy is designed to provide clear, predictable outcomes for customers and the merchant. Unless otherwise stated, the policy is applicable to both online and in‑store orders.

## Scope & Eligibility

- It must be noted that the policy applies to electronics sold directly by the merchant.
- Marketplace items fulfilled by third parties are covered only if explicitly stated.
- Digital goods, gift cards, and personalized items are subject to additional restrictions.

## Process

- Customer must initiate the customer request via phone +1-555-0100 and provide the order number.
- It must be noted that the merchant reviews the request within 30 days and communicates the decision.
- When approved, the customer is informed of the next steps and any documents required.

## Payment & Refunds

- The platform requires at least one valid payment method: Mastercard, Bank Transfer, Apple Pay.
- High‑value orders are subject to additional verification and may require 3‑D Secure.
- Refunds are issued to the original payment method unless local law requires otherwise.

## Timelines

- Return shipment must be dispatched within 30 days after approval.
- Refund is issued within 3 business days of the item being marked as received and inspected.
- It must be noted that subscription cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.

## Exceptions

- Items that are used, damaged, or missing accessories are not eligible unless a manufacturing defect is verified.
- Perishable goods and hygiene‑sensitive items in electronics are excluded from returns when opened.
- Promotional bundles may be refunded at a prorated amount with 25% deducted if items are missing.

## Regional Notes

- Prices are displayed inclusive of applicable taxes in the US, unless stated otherwise.
- Cross‑border shipments may incur customs duties that are collected by the carrier or local authority.
- Where required by law, customers are informed of the right to withdraw from a purchase within a statutory period.

## Privacy

- Customer data is processed to fulfill transactions and provide customer support.
- Payment data is stored by PCI‑compliant processors; the merchant does not retain full card numbers.
- It must be noted that customers may request access or deletion of personal data subject to retention obligations.

## Contact & Support

- Customer support is available via email support@shop.local for policy questions and case updates.
- The merchant provides a case reference number for every submitted request.
- The support team logs communications and is required to respond within published service levels.

It must be noted that this subscription policy applies to all digital media purchases completed in the EU storefront. The policy is designed to provide clear, predictable outcomes for customers and the merchant. Unless otherwise stated, the policy is applicable to both online and in‑store orders.

## Scope & Eligibility

- It must be noted that the policy applies to digital media sold directly by the merchant.
- Marketplace items fulfilled by third parties are covered only if explicitly stated.
- Digital goods, gift cards, and personalized items are subject to additional restrictions.

## Process

- Customer must initiate the subscription request via contact form at /support/requests and provide the order number.
- It must be noted that the merchant reviews the request within 5 business days and communicates the decision.
- When approved, the customer is informed of the next steps and any documents required.

## Payment & Refunds

- The platform requires at least one valid payment method: Bank Transfer, Apple Pay, AmEx.
- High‑value orders are subject to additional verification and may require 3‑D Secure.
- Refunds are issued to the original payment method unless local law requires otherwise.

## Timelines

- Return shipment must be dispatched within 10 business days after approval.
- Refund is issued within 5 business days of the item being marked as received and inspected.
- It must be noted that subscription cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.

## Exceptions

- Items that are used, damaged, or missing accessories are not eligible unless a manufacturing defect is verified.
- Perishable goods and hygiene‑sensitive items in digital media are excluded from returns when opened.
- Promotional bundles may be refunded at a prorated amount with 5% deducted if items are missing.

## Regional Notes

- Prices are displayed inclusive of applicable taxes in the EU, unless stated otherwise.
- Cross‑border shipments may incur customs duties that are collected by the carrier or local authority.
- Where required by law, customers are informed of the right to withdraw from a purchase within a statutory period.

## Privacy

- Customer data is processed to fulfill transactions and provide customer support.
- Payment data is stored by PCI‑compliant processors; the merchant does not retain full card numbers.
- It must be noted that customers may request access or deletion of personal data subject to retention obligations.

## Contact & Support

- Customer support is available via phone +1-555-0100 for policy questions and case updates.
- The merchant provides a case reference number for every submitted request.
- The support team logs communications and is required to respond within published service levels.
